//: How you get around Station Kestrel: the main corridors and maintenance spines are the station's paths.

station_corridor.name: the #ring_word# Corridor
station_corridor.fork_text: A junction here: {branch} branches off toward {toward}.

waypoints.name: Junction #junction_no#
waypoints.description: A pressure-door junction where the corridor meets a cross-passage. Status lights blink amber on every frame.

waypoints.name: Observation Gallery
waypoints.description: A long window looks out on the slow wheel of stars. Someone has left a coffee bulb on the rail.

waypoints.name: Bulkhead #junction_no#
waypoints.description: A heavy bulkhead stands open, its seals scorched. Emergency strips light the deck.

waypoints.name: Crew Lounge
waypoints.description: Bolted-down chairs around a dead entertainment screen. A game of cards was abandoned mid-hand.
